summary: Recent updates to the OpenGL handling in Firefox focused on improving performance and compatibility with graphics across different platforms. A key change is the **removal of cross-process SurfaceTexture syncing**, which streamlines how textures are managed and can lead to faster rendering. Additionally, enhancements like making the GLBlitHelper work with IOSurfaces when using EGL/ANGLE (a way to enable OpenGL ES rendering on various platforms) and implementing the MacIOSurface::BindTexImage() method bolster support for higher quality graphics on macOS systems. These improvements help ensure smoother visual experiences for users, especially in graphic-intensive applications.
